description.narrative:
The Youth Advocacy Bridge is a transformative cross-continental initiative connecting youth from Africa (Ethiopia) and Europe (Croatia) to develop practical advocacy skills for governance accountability, with particular focus on how technological advancements impact democratic participation. Led by SSM JIE in partnership with SPES Institute, this project empowers marginalized youth to monitorgovernance frameworks and advocate for institutional transparency.
The project begins with a focused Targeted Comparative Analysisengaging 12 youth researchers (40% from marginalized backgrounds) to identify key governance gaps across continents. Through structured research sessions examining transparency mechanisms and AI governance impacts, participants will produce a practical 10-page Comparative Governance Toolkit identifying specific accountability gaps that directly inform subsequent activities.
Building on this foundation, the Capacity Building phase will equip 10 youth advocates and organizations through a 3-day international mobility program in Zagreb, Croatia. Training focuses on governance principles, watchdog mechanisms, and ethical considerations in AI deployment, culminating in a practical 5-indicator framework for evaluating governance systems and technological impacts on decision-making.
The Advocacy Training phase will build capacity among 50 young people (25 per continent) through tailored strategies addressing gaps in youth consultation frameworks and AI transparency mechanisms. This training culminates in two concise policy papers addressing governance accountability and technology's impact on democratic processes.
In the Advocacy Campaigns phase, youth will implement two targeted campaigns utilizing the co-created governance indicators to monitor institutional decisions. Strategic meetings between 15 youth advocates and 6 policymakers will focus on institutional reforms that safeguard youth consultation frameworks in the context oftechnological advancement.
The Dissemination phase ensures project outcomes reach 35,000 youth across both continents through institutional submissions and compelling digital storytelling showcasing advocacy achievements, creating sustainable mechanisms for continued youth influence in governance processes.

participating-org.narrative:
Svjetski savez mladih Jugoistočna Europa (SSM JIE) is a Croatian ENGO empowering young people across 19 countries in Southeast Europe, 10 primarily EU member countries, through education, advocacy, and civic action. Engaging over 50,000 youth annually, SSM JIE promotes democratic participation, human rights-based policy advocacy, ethical leadership, and social inclusion, prioritizing rural youth, young women, and urban youth facing socio-economic challenges. With extensive experience in EU-funded projects (Erasmus+, European Solidarity Corps, European Social Fund), SSM JIE strengthens youth engagement in policy processes, civic activism, and institutional dialogue to foster resilient democracies.
Mission: SSM JIE equips young people with the knowledge, skills, and platforms to actively participate in governance, advocacy, and civic leadership, ensuring their voices shape policies and social change.
Vision: ASoutheast Europe where youth are key drivers of EU and national democracies, shaping policyand governance through inclusive, ethical, and informed participation.
Objectives of the organization - Increase youth engagement in democratic processes through advocacy and policy training. - Empower marginalized youth to steer governance structures and influence decision-making. - Foster cross-regional cooperation by connecting youth across Southeast Europe and beyond. - Promote gender equality, ensuring young women have equal leadership opportunities.
Values of the organization - Democratic Participation: Strengthening youth involvement in governance and policy dialogue. - Human Dignity: Upholding fundamental rights and freedoms for all. - Inclusion <(>&<)> Gender Equality: Ensuring marginalized youth, especially young women, access decision-making platforms within the organization and beyond. - Ethical Leadership:Developing informed, proactive, and socially responsible youth leaders.
